translations.HINT_INVALID_CONFIG: Check the configuration value and ensure it matches the expected type and format.
translations.INVALID_CONFIG_SYNTHETIC_EXPORTS_SHAPE: Configuration error: inline exports must be a plain export-map object (a default and/or named exports), received {received}.
translations.HINT_INVALID_CONFIG_SYNTHETIC_EXPORTS_SH: Pass exports as a plain object, e.g. { default: fn } or { name: fn } — or a { exports: { default?, ...named } } wrapper, or a bare function.
translations.INVALID_CONFIG_SYNTHETIC_INPUT: Configuration error: inline content must be a plain export-map object, an exports-wrapper object, or a bare function, received {received}.
translations.HINT_INVALID_CONFIG_SYNTHETIC_INPUT: Pass inline exports as a plain object or a bare function; a filesystem mount needs a string path.
translations.INVALID_CONFIG_SYNTHETIC_NAME: Configuration error: syntheticName must be a non-empty string, received {received}.
translations.HINT_INVALID_CONFIG_SYNTHETIC_NAME: Provide a string key name for the synthetic build, e.g. "synthetic".
translations.INVALID_CONFIG_PRELOADED_STRUCTURE: Configuration error: preloadedStructure must be a plain object with files and directories arrays, received {received}.
translations.HINT_INVALID_CONFIG_PRELOADED_STRUCTURE: preloadedStructure is built internally; pass an object with files and directories arrays, or omit it to scan a directory.
translations.INVALID_CONFIG_DIR_MISSING: Configuration error: 'base' option is required. Provide a directory path to load API from.
translations.HINT_INVALID_CONFIG_DIR_MISSING: The directory path is required but was not provided.
translations.INVALID_CONFIG_DIR_INVALID: Configuration error: 'dir' must be a non-empty string path. Received: {dir}
translations.HINT_INVALID_CONFIG_DIR_INVALID: Ensure the directory path is a valid string and points to an existing directory.
translations.INVALID_CONFIG_BROWSER_REQUIRES_MANIFEST: Configuration error: 'loader.files' is required when loader.platform is 'browser'. Provide a pre-generated manifest object with 'files' and 'directories' arrays.
translations.INVALID_CONFIG_BROWSER_MANIFEST_INVALID: Configuration error: 'loader.files' must be a plain object with 'files' and 'directories' arrays. Received: {received}
translations.INVALID_CONFIG_BROWSER_RESOLVE_SPECIFIER: Configuration error: 'loader.resolve' must be a function when loader.platform is 'browser'. Received: {received}
translations.INVALID_CONFIG_MODE_INVALID: Configuration error: 'mode' must be either 'eager' or 'lazy'. Received: {value}
translations.INVALID_CONFIG_NOT_LOADED: Cannot perform operation '{operation}' - instance not loaded. Call load() first.
translations.HINT_INVALID_CONFIG_NOT_LOADED: The instance must be loaded before performing this operation. Call load() first.
translations.INVALID_CONFIG_LAZY_MATERIALIZATION_FAIL: Failed to materialize lazy proxy for '{apiPath}'. Check that the module loads correctly.
translations.INVALID_CONFIG_NOT_A_FUNCTION: Cannot call '{apiPath}' - not a function (got {actualType}). Check that the module exports a callable function.
translations.INVALID_CONFIG_API_PATH_INVALID: Invalid API path '{apiPath}': {reason}. API paths must be non-empty, properly formatted dot-notation strings that don't conflict with reserved names. Segment at index {index}: '{segment}'.
translations.HINT_INVALID_CONFIG_API_PATH_INVALID: Ensure the API path is a valid dot-notation string (e.g., 'plugins.tools') without empty segments or reserved names (slothlet, shutdown, destroy).
translations.INVALID_CONFIG_FORCE_OVERWRITE_REQUIRES_: Configuration error: collision.force requires a moduleID. Provide a unique moduleID when using overwrite options for API path '{apiPath}'.
translations.HINT_INVALID_CONFIG_FORCE_OVERWRITE_REQU: When using collision.force, you must provide a unique moduleID to track ownership of the overwritten path.
translations.INVALID_METADATA_TARGET: Invalid metadata target: expected {expected}, received {target}. Metadata operations require a function or object reference.
translations.HINT_INVALID_METADATA_TARGET: The target must be a function or object that was loaded through Slothlet. Pass the actual function/object reference, not a string or primitive value.
translations.METADATA_NO_MODULE_ID: Cannot set user metadata: no moduleID found in system metadata. Ensure the target function/object was loaded through Slothlet.
translations.HINT_METADATA_NO_MODULE_ID: Ensure the function/object was loaded through Slothlet's module system. Only Slothlet-managed functions have associated metadata.
translations.METADATA_LIFECYCLE_BYPASS: tagSystemMetadata() must be called through the lifecycle system. Use lifecycle.emit('impl:created') or lifecycle.emit('impl:changed') instead of a direct call.
translations.HINT_METADATA_LIFECYCLE_BYPASS: Never call tagSystemMetadata() directly. Trigger the 'impl:created' or 'impl:changed' lifecycle events instead, which will invoke tagSystemMetadata() through the proper channel.
translations.INVALID_METADATA_KEY: Invalid metadata key: expected {expected}, received {type} for key '{key}'. Metadata keys must be properly formatted.
translations.HINT_INVALID_METADATA_KEY: Metadata keys must be strings, string arrays, or objects with array values. Check the key format matches one of these types.
translations.WARNING_METADATA_MISMATCH: Security warning: Metadata file path mismatch for '{apiPath}'. Stack trace shows '{stackFile}' but metadata shows '{metadataFile}'. This may indicate hot reload or tampering.
translations.HINT_WARNING_METADATA_MISMATCH: This warning indicates the function's execution location doesn't match its registered metadata path. This can occur during hot reload or if the function was tampered with. In most cases, this is expected during development with hot reload enabled.
translations.COLLISION_ERROR: Collision error at '{key}' (context: {collisionContext}, mode: {collisionMode}). Set collision mode to 'merge', 'replace', 'warn', or 'skip' to handle collisions.
translations.HINT_COLLISION_ERROR: Collision mode is set to 'error' which prevents any overwrites. Use api.collision: 'merge' (combine properties), 'replace' (overwrite completely), 'warn' (warn but keep existing), or 'skip' (silently ignore) instead.
translations.COLLISION_DEFAULT_EXPORT_ERROR: Collision detected: property '{key}' already exists on default export at '{apiPath}'. Collision mode is 'error'.
translations.HINT_COLLISION_DEFAULT_EXPORT_ERROR: A named export conflicts with a property already present on the default export object at this path. Change the collision mode to 'merge', 'replace', 'warn', or 'skip', or rename the conflicting property.
translations.HINT_INVALID_ARGUMENT: Path must be a dot-notation string (e.g., 'math.add').
translations.API_LEAVES_UNKNOWN_MODULE: No module found for '{key}'. Pass a moduleID returned by api.add(), a mount endpoint or owned api path, or '.' for the base load.
translations.HINT_API_LEAVES_UNKNOWN_MODULE: leaves() resolves its key against the ownership records: a moduleID, the path a module was mounted at, or any path that module owns. List current mounts via api.slothlet.owner.get().
translations.RUNTIME_NO_ACTIVE_CONTEXT: No active context found. This operation requires being called from within a slothlet API function.
translations.HINT_RUNTIME_NO_ACTIVE_CONTEXT: metadata.self() must be called from within a slothlet API function.
translations.INVALID_CONFIG_MUTATIONS_DISABLED: Cannot perform '{operation}' - mutation is disabled. Set api.mutations to enable API modification operations (add/remove/reload).
translations.HINT_INVALID_CONFIG_MUTATIONS_DISABLED: API mutation operations require api.mutations in the configuration. Use diagnostics: true to access these methods for testing without enabling actual mutations.
translations.WARNING_API_ADD_OPTION_LOCKED: '{option}' passed to api.add() was ignored — collision / internal policy is set at init, not per call. Use the `api.collision` config at slothlet() init, `collision.force` for a targeted replace, or set api.collision.override to true to honour per-call overrides.
translations.HINT_WARNING_API_ADD_OPTION_LOCKED: collision.mode, collision.mutate and replay are locked so a runtime mount cannot bypass the instance's collision policy; collision.force stays available for a targeted replace.
translations.CACHE_MODULEID_MISMATCH: Cache entry moduleID mismatch: expected '{cacheKey}', but entry has '{entryModuleID}'. This indicates an internal cache inconsistency.
translations.HINT_CACHE_MODULEID_MISMATCH: This is an internal error indicating cache corruption. Please report this issue with steps to reproduce.
translations.CACHE_NOT_FOUND: Cache entry not found for moduleID '{moduleID}' during '{operation}' operation. The module may not be loaded or the cache may have been cleared.
translations.HINT_CACHE_NOT_FOUND: Ensure the module has been loaded before attempting to reload or rebuild its cache. Check that the moduleID is correct.
translations.CACHE_MANAGER_NOT_AVAILABLE: Cache manager is not available. Cannot perform '{operation}' operation. Ensure the cache manager is initialized.
translations.HINT_CACHE_MANAGER_NOT_AVAILABLE: The cache manager should be initialized automatically. If you see this error, it may indicate an internal initialization issue.
translations.HINT_MODULE_LOAD_FAILED: Check the module file for errors. Ensure it has valid JavaScript syntax and exports.
translations.HINT_MODULE_NOT_FOUND: Ensure the module exists and the path is correct. Check for typos in the import statement.
translations.MODULE_RESERVED_FILENAME: Module file '{file}' in '{dir}' is named for a framework-reserved key and cannot be loaded.
translations.HINT_MODULE_RESERVED_FILENAME: Reserved names (INTERNAL_KEYS such as ___materialize, ____impl) are the framework's own wrapper handles; a module file by that name would overwrite them during child adoption. Rename the file.
translations.MODULE_RESERVED_DIRNAME: Folder '{folder}' in '{dir}' is named for a framework-reserved key and cannot be loaded.
translations.HINT_MODULE_RESERVED_DIRNAME: Reserved names (___materialize, ____impl) are the framework's own wrapper handles; a folder by that name would overwrite them. Rename the folder.
translations.MODULE_THENABLE_NAME: '{entry}' in '{dir}' is named 'then', which would make its api namespace awaitable, and cannot be loaded.
translations.HINT_MODULE_THENABLE_NAME: A member named then makes its namespace thenable: every await of the namespace would call it instead of resolving the namespace. Rename the file or folder.
translations.API_MEMBER_THEN_RESERVED: Cannot set a callable 'then' on '{apiPath}': it would make that api node awaitable.
translations.HINT_API_MEMBER_THEN_RESERVED: A then method on an api node would be called by every await of the node instead of resolving it. A then holding data is fine. Use a different name for the method.
translations.API_MEMBER_FIXED_OBJECT: Cannot define '{apiPath}' read-only and non-configurable holding an object or function in one step while permissions are on: it would have to be handed out as it is, unchecked.
translations.HINT_API_MEMBER_FIXED_OBJECT: Assign the member first, then lock it: {apiPath} = value; Object.defineProperty(node, key, { writable: false, configurable: false }).
translations.MODULE_RESERVED_EXPORT: Module export '{name}' uses a reserved name and cannot be loaded.
translations.HINT_MODULE_RESERVED_EXPORT: Reserved export names are the framework's own wrapper handles (___materialize, ____impl, ...), which such an export could only ever be shadowed by. Rename the export.
translations.MODULE_THENABLE_EXPORT: '{location}' has a callable 'then', which would make its api node awaitable, and cannot be loaded.
translations.HINT_MODULE_THENABLE_EXPORT: slothlet awaits api nodes and module values (await api.x resolves the node, and lazy mode loads by awaiting), so a then method or then accessor would be called instead. A then holding data is fine. Rename the method, or keep the thenable off the exported value.
translations.MODULE_ID_RESERVED_SEPARATOR: Module ID '{moduleID}' contains the reserved separator '{separator}' and cannot be used.
translations.HINT_MODULE_ID_RESERVED_SEPARATOR: slothlet joins a module's id and api path with this token internally; a module id containing it would corrupt that key. Choose a different id.
translations.MODULE_ID_IN_USE: Module ID '{moduleID}' belongs to another module that is mounted; module code may mount only with its own moduleID or one not in use.
translations.HINT_MODULE_ID_IN_USE: Choose a moduleID that is not in use, or the calling module's own.
translations.MODULE_IMPORT_FAILED: Failed to import module '{modulePath}': {error}. Check that the file exists and has valid syntax.
translations.HINT_MODULE_IMPORT_FAILED: Ensure the module file exists and can be imported. Check for syntax errors or missing dependencies.
translations.INSTANCE_ID_IN_USE: Instance ID '{instanceID}' is already in use in this process. Its files cannot be loaded under the same ID twice.
translations.HINT_INSTANCE_ID_IN_USE: Each instance needs an ID of its own. Shut the other instance down first, or let slothlet generate the ID.
translations.MODULE_INTERNAL_NOT_IMPORTABLE: '{specifier}' ({file}) is part of slothlet's own files, which only slothlet's own files and the host may import or use. A module's files may import {allowed}.
translations.HINT_MODULE_INTERNAL_NOT_IMPORTABLE: Reach other modules through self, and keep slothlet's own files to the host's code.
translations.CONTEXT_ALREADY_EXISTS: Context for instance '{instanceID}' already exists. Cannot initialize twice.
translations.HINT_CONTEXT_ALREADY_EXISTS: This context already exists. Check if you're trying to initialize the same instance twice.
translations.CONTEXT_NOT_FOUND: Context not found for instance '{instanceID}'. Instance may have been shut down. Available instances: {availableInstances}
translations.HINT_CONTEXT_NOT_FOUND: Ensure the slothlet instance is initialized and the context is created before accessing it. Check that you're using the correct instance ID.
translations.CONTEXT_EXECUTION_FAILED: Failed to execute in context for instance '{instanceID}': {error}
translations.HINT_CONTEXT_EXECUTION_FAILED: An error occurred while executing the function. Check the error details for more information.
translations.NO_ACTIVE_CONTEXT_LIVE: No active context - no instance is currently active in live bindings mode.
translations.HINT_NO_ACTIVE_CONTEXT_LIVE: No active context found. Ensure you're calling this function from within a slothlet live context.
translations.NO_ACTIVE_CONTEXT_ASYNC: No active context - function must be called within slothlet API context.
translations.HINT_NO_ACTIVE_CONTEXT_ASYNC: No active context found. Ensure you're calling this function from within a slothlet async context.
translations.RUNTIME_NO_ACTIVE_CONTEXT_SELF: No active context - cannot access 'self'. Ensure you're calling from within a Slothlet API function.
translations.HINT_RUNTIME_NO_ACTIVE_CONTEXT_SELF: Cannot access 'self' outside of a slothlet API function context.
translations.RUNTIME_NO_ACTIVE_CONTEXT_CONTEXT: No active context - 'context' can only be modified within slothlet API calls.
translations.HINT_RUNTIME_NO_ACTIVE_CONTEXT_CONTEXT: Cannot access 'context' outside of a slothlet API function. Context can only be modified within slothlet API calls.
translations.OWNERSHIP_INVALID_MODULE_ID: Invalid ownership registration: moduleID '{moduleID}' is invalid.
translations.HINT_OWNERSHIP_INVALID_MODULE_ID: The module ID is invalid. Ensure the module was loaded properly and the ID is correct.
translations.OWNERSHIP_INVALID_API_PATH: Invalid ownership registration: apiPath '{apiPath}' is invalid.
translations.HINT_OWNERSHIP_INVALID_API_PATH: The API path is invalid. Ensure the path format is correct.
translations.OWNERSHIP_CONFLICT: Ownership conflict: Path '{apiPath}' is already owned by module '{existingModuleId}', cannot assign to '{newModuleId}'. Use collision: { force: true } or removeApi first.
translations.HINT_OWNERSHIP_CONFLICT: Path is already owned by another module. Options: (1) Use collision: { force: true } in api.add() options, (2) Set collision config to 'merge' or 'replace', (3) Call api.slothlet.api.remove() first to clear the path.
translations.LOOSE_SET_NOT_OWNED: Module {callerApiPath} is not permitted to write to {apiPath}. A module may write only under its own apiPath; use api.slothlet.api.add() to register at a different path.
translations.HINT_LOOSE_SET_NOT_OWNED: A module owning apiPath "P" may write only under "P.*". To register code at a different namespace, call api.slothlet.api.add() instead.
translations.API_ROOT_CLOSED: The api root is sealed, frozen or closed to new members, so {operation} cannot rebuild it.
translations.HINT_API_ROOT_CLOSED: A closed api root keeps the members it holds, as a closed object does. Reload a member with api.slothlet.api.reload(), or close the members you want fixed instead of the root.
translations.LOOSE_SET_UNATTRIBUTED: A write to {apiPath} cannot be attributed to one module: the code running matches several suspended calls, so the write is refused.
translations.HINT_LOOSE_SET_UNATTRIBUTED: Under the live runtime, code that resumes in a file several in-flight calls share cannot be told apart. Await the call before writing, or keep the write in a file only one api path imports.
translations.LOOSE_SET_RESERVED_KEY: Cannot assign to reserved key segment '{segment}' in apiPath '{apiPath}'. Names like __proto__, prototype, and constructor are blocked to prevent prototype pollution of the API tree.
translations.HINT_LOOSE_SET_RESERVED_KEY: The segments __proto__, prototype, and constructor cannot be used as apiPath names because writing to them would mutate the JavaScript prototype chain. Choose a different name.
translations.INVALID_DIRECTORY: Invalid directory '{dir}': {error}. Ensure the directory exists and is accessible.
translations.HINT_INVALID_DIRECTORY: Ensure the directory path is correct and the directory exists and is accessible.
translations.WARN_DIRECTORY_EMPTY: Directory '{dir}' (resolved: '{resolvedPath}') is empty or contains no loadable modules (.mjs, .cjs, .js files). This is valid for add-api workflows but may indicate a misconfigured path.
translations.HINT_WARN_DIRECTORY_EMPTY: Check that the directory path is correct. Empty directories are valid for add-api workflows where modules will be added dynamically.
translations.WARN_SYNTHETIC_ROOT_EMPTY: Synthetic add at api path '{apiPath}' contributed no leaves; nothing was mounted.
translations.HINT_WARN_SYNTHETIC_ROOT_EMPTY: Provide at least one export — a named function default or named exports — so the synthetic add has something to mount.
translations.WARN_SYNTHETIC_ROOT_UNNAMED: Synthetic add at the API root has an anonymous default export; it cannot be keyed onto the root and was skipped.
translations.HINT_WARN_SYNTHETIC_ROOT_UNNAMED: Name the default function (its name becomes the root key), provide named exports, or mount the leaf at a named apiPath.
translations.WARN_SYNTHETIC_ROOT_COLLISION: Synthetic add at the API root re-keys its default to '{name}', but a named export already uses '{name}'; the named export takes precedence.
translations.HINT_WARN_SYNTHETIC_ROOT_COLLISION: Rename the default function or the conflicting named export so each lands on a distinct root key.
translations.INTERNAL_HOOK_STATE_CORRUPT: [INTERNAL ERROR] HookManager state is corrupt: hook "{hookId}" ({type}/{subset}/{pattern}) — {detail}. This is a bug in Slothlet — please report it.
translations.HINT_INTERNAL_HOOK_STATE_CORRUPT: HookManager internal state is inconsistent. This should never happen through normal usage — please file a bug report including how you called hook.on() and hook.remove().
translations.WARNING_RESERVED_PROPERTY_CONFLICT: User API conflicts with reserved properties: {properties}
translations.HINT_WARNING_RESERVED_PROPERTY_CONFLICT: The 'slothlet' property name is reserved for built-in API methods. Rename your API module or property to avoid conflicts with slothlet.shutdown(), slothlet.api.*, etc.
translations.WARNING_LANGUAGE_LOAD_FAILED: Failed to load language '{lang}', falling back to English.
translations.WARNING_LANGUAGE_UNAVAILABLE: Language '{lang}' is not available, using English.
translations.WARNING_OWNERSHIP_CONFLICT: Ownership conflict at '{apiPath}': already owned by '{existingModuleId}', cannot register '{newModuleId}'. Keeping existing.
translations.HINT_WARNING_OWNERSHIP_CONFLICT: The path is already owned by another module. To force overwrite, use collision: { force: true } in api.add() options, or call api.slothlet.api.remove() first to clear the path.
translations.WARNING_HOT_RELOAD_PATH_COLLISION: Path collision at {apiPath} - keeping existing value (collision mode: warn).
translations.HINT_WARNING_HOT_RELOAD_PATH_COLLISION: A collision occurred during hot reload at the specified path. The existing value is being kept. To force replacement, use collision mode 'replace' instead of 'warn'.
translations.WARNING_HOT_RELOAD_MERGE_PRIMITIVES: Cannot merge primitive values at {apiPath} - keeping existing value. Use collision mode 'replace' to overwrite or ensure both values are objects.
translations.HINT_WARNING_HOT_RELOAD_MERGE_PRIMITIVES: Cannot merge primitive values (strings, numbers, booleans). To replace the value, use collision mode 'replace'. To keep the existing value, continue using 'warn' mode.
translations.WARNING_COLLISION_FILE_FOLDER_MERGE: Collision detected at '{key}' - merging file and folder exports (collision mode: 'warn').
translations.HINT_WARNING_COLLISION_FILE_FOLDER_MERGE: A file and a folder share the same name at '{key}'. Their exports are being merged. Rename one to avoid ambiguity, or set api.collision.mode to 'replace' or 'error' if merging is not intended.
translations.WARNING_COLLISION_DEFAULT_EXPORT_OVERWRI: Collision warning: property '{key}' already exists on default export function at {apiPath}. Named export will overwrite.
translations.HINT_WARNING_COLLISION_DEFAULT_EXPORT_OV: The named export '{key}' at '{apiPath}' is overwriting an existing property on the default export function. Rename the export or use a different apiPath to avoid the collision.
translations.WARNING_COLLISION_TRIGGER_MATERIALIZE_ER: Early materialization failed for lazy folder at '{apiPath}'. The collision replacement may be incomplete.
translations.HINT_WARNING_COLLISION_TRIGGER_MATERIALI: This is a non-critical background error during collision handling. The lazy folder at the given path failed to materialize. Check that the module at that path is valid and can be loaded.
translations.WARNING_LIFECYCLE_HANDLER_ERROR: Lifecycle event handler threw an error for event '{event}'. Other handlers for this event continued executing.
translations.HINT_WARNING_LIFECYCLE_HANDLER_ERROR: A lifecycle handler registered for the '{event}' event threw an error. Check your lifecycle.on('{event}', ...) handler for bugs. Other handlers in the same event are not affected.
translations.WARNING_LIFECYCLE_HANDLER_ERROR_AT_PATH: Lifecycle event handler threw an error for event '{event}' at '{apiPath}' (module '{moduleID}'). Other handlers for this event continued executing.
translations.WARNING_EVENT_HANDLER_ERROR: Event listener threw an error for event '{event}'. Other listeners for this event continued executing.
translations.HINT_WARNING_EVENT_HANDLER_ERROR: An event listener registered for the '{event}' event threw an error. Check your event.on('{event}', ...) listener for bugs. Other listeners in the same event are not affected.
translations.WARNING_MULTIPLE_ROOT_CONTRIBUTORS: Multiple root-level default function exports detected: {rootContributors}. Each has been namespaced by filename (e.g., api.{firstContributor}()). Consider using a single root-level default export or moving files to subdirectories.
translations.HINT_WARNING_MULTIPLE_ROOT_CONTRIBUTORS: Multiple files export default functions at the root level. Each has been namespaced (e.g., api.filename()). Consider consolidating into one root export or moving files to subdirectories for clearer organization.
translations.DEBUG_MODE_ROOT_CONTRIBUTOR_APPLIED: [{mode}] Root contributor pattern applied - function API with {properties} additional properties
translations.DEBUG_MODE_COLLISION_SET_MODE_EXISTING_W: [COLLISION]: Setting collision mode on EXISTING wrapper
translations.DEBUG_MODE_COLLISION_SET_MODE_VALUE_WRAP: [COLLISION]: Setting collision mode on VALUE wrapper
translations.DEBUG_MODE_COLLISION_REPLACE_NO_COPY: [COLLISION-REPLACE]: Not copying file properties - replace mode will clear everything on materialization
translations.DEBUG_MODE_SINGLE_FILE_FOLDER_WRAPPED: Single-file folder set to wrapped property
translations.DEBUG_MODE_FLATTEN_MULTI_EXPORT_BLOCKED: Flatten multi-export key blocked by safeAssign
translations.DEBUG_MODE_FILE_FOLDER_COLLISION_MERGED: File-folder collision: merged file exports into folder impl
translations.DEBUG_MODE_MUTATE_API_VALUE_SYNC_WRAPPER: mutateApiValue - both are wrappers, calling syncWrapper
translations.DEBUG_MODE_MUTATE_API_VALUE_MERGE_INTO_W: mutateApiValue - merging properties into existing wrapper
translations.DEBUG_MODE_RULE_13_DEDUP_HOISTED_KEY: Rule 13 C34: AddApi path deduplication - hoisted duplicate key
translations.DEBUG_MODE_AWAITING_PENDING_MATERIALIZAT: Awaiting {count} pending materialization(s) before completing add
translations.DEBUG_MODE_NO_CACHES_ATTEMPTING_RESTORE: No caches found for path, attempting base restore
translations.DEBUG_MODE_ROOT_KEY_RESET_LAZY: Root key reset to lazy via ___resetLazy
translations.DEBUG_MODE_ADOPT_SKIP_SAME_WRAPPER: [ADOPT-SKIP]: property already exists with same wrapper
translations.DEBUG_MODE_WAITING_GET_IMMEDIATE_MAT: [WAITING-GET-IMMEDIATE-MAT]: triggering immediate materialization for collision-merged folder
translations.HINT_REFERENCE_REMOVED: The 'reference' export has been removed from '@cldmv/slothlet/runtime'. Reference objects are now merged directly into the API. Access them via 'self.*' instead (e.g., 'self.myRefProperty').
translations.HINT_SYNTAX_ERROR: Check for syntax errors in the module file. Common issues: missing brackets, unclosed strings, or invalid JavaScript syntax.
translations.INVALID_HOOK_HANDLER: Hook handler must be a function. Received type: {receivedType}.
translations.HINT_INVALID_HOOK_HANDLER: Provide a function as the hook handler, not a string or other type.
translations.DUPLICATE_HOOK_ID: A hook with ID "{id}" already exists. Use a unique ID or omit the id option to auto-generate one.
translations.HINT_DUPLICATE_HOOK_ID: Either use a different id value or remove the id option to let Slothlet auto-generate a unique ID.
translations.INVALID_HOOK_SUBSET: Invalid hook subset "{subset}". Must be "before", "primary", or "after". Valid subsets: {validSubsets}.
translations.HINT_INVALID_HOOK_SUBSET: Subsets control execution order. Use 'before' for pre-processing, 'primary' (default) for main hooks, or 'after' for post-processing.
translations.HINT_INVALID_TYPE_PATTERN: Hook patterns use the form 'pattern:type', such as 'math.*:before' or '**:error'. The legacy 'type:pattern' form still works but is deprecated.
translations.HOOK_BEFORE_RETURNED_PROMISE: Before hook '{id}' for path '{path}' returned a Promise in a synchronous pipeline.
translations.HINT_HOOK_BEFORE_RETURNED_PROMISE: A 'before' handler was not detected as asynchronous. Use a native async function, or register it with { async: true }, so the call promotes to the asynchronous pipeline.
translations.HOOK_AFTER_RETURNED_PROMISE: After hook '{id}' for path '{path}' returned a Promise in a synchronous pipeline.
translations.HINT_HOOK_AFTER_RETURNED_PROMISE: An 'after' handler was not detected as asynchronous. Use a native async function, or register it with { async: true }, so the call promotes to the asynchronous pipeline.
translations.HOOK_PROMOTED_RESULT_NOT_AWAITED: Path '{path}' returned a Promise because an asynchronous hook is attached — await the result.
translations.HINT_HOOK_PROMOTED_RESULT_NOT_AWAITED: A synchronous target promotes to asynchronous dispatch while an async before/after hook is attached. Await the call, or remove the async hook to restore synchronous returns.
translations.HOOK_AROUND_RETURNED_PROMISE: Around hook '{id}' for path '{path}' returned a Promise in a synchronous pipeline.
translations.HINT_HOOK_AROUND_RETURNED_PROMISE: An 'around' handler was not detected as asynchronous. Use a native async function, or register it with { async: true }, so the call promotes to the asynchronous pipeline. When next() returned a thenable, returning that one, one derived from it such as next().then(check), or any other thenable is always allowed.
translations.HOOK_AROUND_NEXT_CALLED_TWICE: Around hook '{id}' for path '{path}' called next() more than once.
translations.HINT_HOOK_AROUND_NEXT_CALLED_TWICE: next() runs the rest of the pipeline exactly once per around-hook invocation. Call it once and reuse its result, or make a separate call through the API to run the target again.
translations.HOOK_AROUND_NEXT_INVALID_ARGS: Around hook '{id}' for path '{path}' called next() with a {received}; expected an array of arguments.
translations.HINT_HOOK_AROUND_NEXT_INVALID_ARGS: Call next() with no argument to forward the current arguments, or pass an array to replace them.
translations.HOOK_BRACE_EXPANSION_MAX_DEPTH: Brace expansion in hook pattern exceeds the maximum nesting depth of {maxDepth}.
translations.HINT_HOOK_BRACE_EXPANSION_MAX_DEPTH: Simplify the hook path pattern to reduce brace nesting. Maximum allowed depth is {maxDepth} levels.
translations.SCOPE_DISABLED: Per-request context isolation is disabled. Set 'scope: {}' in your slothlet configuration to enable it.
translations.HINT_SCOPE_DISABLED: Add 'scope: {}' (or a scope config object) to your slothlet options to enable per-request context isolation via api.slothlet.context.run() and api.slothlet.context.scope().
translations.SCOPE_INVALID_CONTEXT: Context data must be a plain object. Received: {received}.
translations.HINT_SCOPE_INVALID_CONTEXT: Pass a plain object as the first argument to run(), e.g. api.slothlet.context.run({ userId: 1 }, callback).
translations.SCOPE_INVALID_CALLBACK: Callback must be a function. Received: {received}.
translations.HINT_SCOPE_INVALID_CALLBACK: Pass a function as the second argument to run(), e.g. api.slothlet.context.run(context, async () => { ... }).
translations.SCOPE_INVALID_OPTIONS: Options must be a plain object. Received: {received}.
translations.HINT_SCOPE_INVALID_OPTIONS: Pass a plain options object to scope(), e.g. api.slothlet.context.scope({ fn: myFunc, context: {} }).
translations.HINT_SCOPE_INVALID_FN: Set options.fn to the function you want to execute in the isolated context.
translations.SCOPE_INVALID_CONTEXT_OBJECT: 'context' must be a plain object. Received: {received}.
translations.HINT_SCOPE_INVALID_CONTEXT_OBJECT: Set options.context to a plain object containing the per-request data to inject.
translations.SCOPE_INVALID_MERGE_STRATEGY: Invalid merge strategy '{merge}'. Must be 'shallow' or 'deep'.
translations.HINT_SCOPE_INVALID_MERGE_STRATEGY: Use merge: 'shallow' (default) for a top-level merge of the context object, or merge: 'deep' for a recursive deep merge.
translations.SCOPE_INVALID_ISOLATION_MODE: Invalid isolation mode '{isolationMode}'. Must be 'partial' or 'full'.
translations.HINT_SCOPE_INVALID_ISOLATION_MODE: Use isolation: 'partial' (default) to inherit the parent context and overlay new values, or isolation: 'full' to start with a completely fresh context.
translations.CHAIN_ACCESS_UNDEFINED: Cannot access '{prop}' on undefined while traversing '{apiPath}.{chainLabel}'.
translations.HINT_CHAIN_ACCESS_UNDEFINED: A property in the method chain resolved to undefined before reaching the target. Check that every intermediate property in the chain is a valid API path.
translations.HINT_CHAIN_MATERIALIZE_FAILED: The lazy API module at this path failed to load. Check that the module file exists and exports valid values.
translations.CHAIN_NOT_CALLABLE: '{apiPath}.{chainLabel}' is not callable or does not exist.
translations.HINT_CHAIN_NOT_CALLABLE: The chained property resolved to a non-function value. Ensure the API path refers to a function, or check that the module exports the expected function.
translations.LAZY_SUBCLASS_BEFORE_LOAD: '{apiPath}' cannot be subclassed before it has loaded.
translations.HINT_LAZY_SUBCLASS_BEFORE_LOAD: Await the node first (await api.{apiPath}) and extend what it resolves to, or load it with eager mode.
translations.LAZY_WRITE_REFUSED: A change ({operation}) made on '{apiPath}' before it loaded was refused once it loaded: {error}
translations.HINT_LAZY_WRITE_REFUSED: In lazy mode a change made through a node that has not loaded yet is made when it loads, and the loaded node refused this one, as it would have in eager mode. Await the node before changing it to see a refusal where the change is made.
translations.WARNING_LAZY_WRITE_REFUSED: A change ({operation}) made on '{apiPath}' before it loaded was refused once it loaded and was not made.
translations.HINT_WARNING_LAZY_WRITE_REFUSED: The next await of '{apiPath}', or call through it, made before it loaded is rejected with the same refusal. Await the node before changing it to see a refusal where the change is made.
translations.TYPESCRIPT_ESBUILD_NOT_INSTALLED: TypeScript {mode} mode requires 'esbuild' to be installed.
translations.HINT_TYPESCRIPT_ESBUILD_NOT_INSTALLED: Install it with: npm install esbuild
translations.TYPESCRIPT_TSC_NOT_INSTALLED: TypeScript {mode} mode requires 'typescript' to be installed.
translations.HINT_TYPESCRIPT_TSC_NOT_INSTALLED: Install it with: npm install typescript
translations.TYPESCRIPT_STRICT_REQUIRES_TS6: TypeScript strict mode requires the TypeScript 6 compiler API; the installed 'typescript' package (version {version}) does not expose it. TypeScript 7 will not expose a stable compiler API until version 7.1.
translations.HINT_TYPESCRIPT_STRICT_REQUIRES_TS6: Install typescript@6 for strict mode: npm install typescript@6. Fast mode (esbuild) and 'slothlet typegen' work fine with TypeScript 7.
translations.TS_STRICT_REQUIRES_OUTPUT: TypeScript strict mode requires 'types.output' to be configured in your typescript config.
translations.HINT_TS_STRICT_REQUIRES_OUTPUT: Add 'types: { output: './types/api.d.ts', name: 'MyAPI' }' to your typescript configuration.
translations.TS_STRICT_REQUIRES_INTERFACE_NAME: TypeScript strict mode requires 'types.name' to be configured in your typescript config.
translations.HINT_TS_STRICT_REQUIRES_INTERFACE_NAME: Add 'name' to your 'types' config, e.g. types: { output: './types/api.d.ts', name: 'MyAPI' }.
translations.HINT_TS_TYPE_GENERATION_FAILED: The child process that generates TypeScript declarations encountered an error. Check the error message for details and ensure the TypeScript source files are valid.
translations.TS_TYPE_GENERATION_FORK_FAILED: Failed to fork the type generation process: {error}
translations.HINT_TS_TYPE_GENERATION_FORK_FAILED: The type generation worker process could not be started. Ensure Node.js has permission to fork child processes and that the lib/processors/type-generation-worker.mjs script exists.
translations.TS_TYPE_GENERATION_WORKER_NO_CONFIG: The type generation worker was started without its configuration (SLOTHLET_CONFIG is not set).
translations.HINT_TS_TYPE_GENERATION_WORKER_NO_CONFIG: This worker is started by strict TypeScript mode with its configuration in the SLOTHLET_CONFIG environment variable. Let slothlet fork it rather than running the file directly.
translations.TS_TYPE_GENERATION_PROCESS_EXITED: Type generation process exited with code {code}: {output}
translations.HINT_TS_TYPE_GENERATION_PROCESS_EXITED: The type generation child process exited with a non-zero code. Check the output for compiler errors and verify the TypeScript sources are valid.
translations.HINT_TS_TYPE_CHECK_ERRORS: Fix the TypeScript type errors listed above in the source file, or set typescript.strict to false to skip type checking.
translations.FLATTEN_REASON_ADDAPI_METADATA_DEFAULT: AddApi special file pattern with metadata default
translations.FLATTEN_REASON_ADDAPI_SPECIAL_FILE: AddApi special file pattern - always flatten
translations.FLATTEN_REASON_ADDAPI_SPECIAL_FILE_PAREN: AddApi special file pattern with metadata default - flatten named exports to parent
translations.FLATTEN_REASON_DEFAULT_OBJECT_EXPORT_FLA: Default object export matches folder name
translations.FLATTEN_REASON_SINGLE_EXPORT_MATCHES_MOD: Single named export matches module name (final check)
translations.INVALID_CONFIG_PATH_TYPE: Path must be a directory or a supported file type (.mjs, .cjs, .js). Got: {path}
translations.HINT_INVALID_CONFIG_PATH_TYPE: Ensure the path points to a directory or a JavaScript module file with a .mjs, .cjs, or .js extension.
translations.INVALID_CONFIG_FILE_TYPE: File must have a .mjs, .cjs, or .js extension. Got: {extension} for {path}
translations.HINT_INVALID_CONFIG_FILE_TYPE: Rename the file to use a supported extension (.mjs for ES modules, .cjs for CommonJS, .js for either).
translations.API_PATH_REASON_RESERVED_NAME: conflicts with reserved names (slothlet, shutdown, destroy)
translations.API_PATH_REASON_UNSAFE_SEGMENT: contains an unsafe segment (__proto__, constructor, prototype) that would pollute the prototype chain
translations.API_PATH_REASON_THENABLE_SEGMENT: contains a 'then' segment, which would make that namespace awaitable
translations.API_PATH_REASON_INVALID_TYPE: must be a string, array of strings, empty string (root), or null/undefined (root)
translations.API_PATH_REASON_COLLISION_ERROR: path already exists and collision mode is 'error'
translations.API_PATH_REASON_NOT_TRAVERSABLE: path segment does not exist or is not traversable
translations.API_PATH_REASON_REQUIRED: apiPath is required for removeApi operation
translations.API_PATH_REASON_VERSIONED_ROOT: versioned API components cannot be mounted at the root path; provide a dot-separated path such as 'auth' or 'v1.auth'
translations.API_PATH_REASON_RESERVED_SEPARATOR: contains the reserved internal separator token, which is not permitted in an API path
translations.INVALID_API_PATH: Invalid API path: '{apiPath}' does not exist in the loaded API.
translations.HINT_INVALID_API_PATH: Ensure the API path exists before using it. Use a dot-separated path (e.g. 'math.add') that refers to a currently loaded module.
translations.HOOKS_NOT_INITIALIZED: Cannot access hook functionality: the hook manager is not initialized.
translations.HINT_HOOKS_NOT_INITIALIZED: Hook support requires 'hooks: true' in your slothlet configuration.
translations.METADATA_NOT_AVAILABLE: Cannot access metadata functionality: the metadata handler is not initialized. Available handlers: {handlersKeys}. This is an internal bug - please report it.
translations.HINT_METADATA_NOT_AVAILABLE: Metadata support is built-in. If the metadata handler is missing, this indicates an internal slothlet initialization error.
translations.NO_CONTEXT_MANAGER: No context manager is configured for this slothlet instance.
translations.HINT_NO_CONTEXT_MANAGER: Context operations require a context manager. Initialize slothlet with 'contextManager: new AsyncContextManager()' or 'contextManager: new LiveContextManager()' in your configuration.
translations.UNSUPPORTED_CONTEXT_MANAGER: Unsupported context manager: '{manager}'. Only AsyncContextManager and LiveContextManager are supported.
translations.HINT_UNSUPPORTED_CONTEXT_MANAGER: Use AsyncContextManager for async/ALS-based context isolation or LiveContextManager for synchronous live-binding context.
translations.INVALID_CONFIG_VERSION_DISPATCHER: config.versioning.dispatcher must be a string (metadata key) or a function, received {received}
translations.INVALID_CONFIG_IMPORT: Invalid 'loader.import' option: expected a function, received {received}.
translations.HINT_INVALID_CONFIG_IMPORT: The injectable leaf importer replaces the loader's native dynamic import. Pass a function like (url) => import(url) — typically one bound to your test runner so leaf coverage attributes.
translations.INVALID_CONFIG_VERSION_TAG: options.version.tag must be a non-empty string, received {received}
translations.VERSION_NOT_FOUND: Version '{version}' is not registered at path '{apiPath}'
translations.HINT_VERSION_NOT_FOUND: Call api.slothlet.versioning.list('{apiPath}') to see which version tags are currently registered at that path.
translations.VERSION_NO_DEFAULT: No default version configured for path '{apiPath}' and no version could be resolved from caller metadata
translations.VERSION_DISPATCH_NOT_CALLABLE: The versioned dispatcher at '{apiPath}' is a namespace, not a callable function
translations.VERSION_REGISTER_DUPLICATE: Version '{version}' is already registered at path '{apiPath}'. Use collision.mode 'replace' to overwrite
translations.HINT_VERSION_REGISTER_DUPLICATE: Call api.slothlet.versioning.remove('{apiPath}', '{version}') first, or register with a different version tag.
translations.VERSION_DISCRIMINATOR_INVALID_RETURN: versioning.dispatcher function returned '{returned}' which is not a registered version tag for path '{apiPath}'
translations.DEBUG_VERSION_DEFAULT_USED: No discriminator match for path {apiPath}; using default version {version}
translations.PERMISSION_DENIED: Access denied: caller '{caller}' is not permitted to access '{target}'
translations.HINT_PERMISSION_DENIED: Check permission rules for this caller/target pair. Use api.slothlet.permissions.global.rules.path('{target}') to inspect active rules.
translations.CAPABILITY_REFUSED: Built-in capability '{capability}' ({route}) is refused to '{caller}' whilst the permission system is on: {reason}.
translations.HINT_CAPABILITY_REFUSED: The host opens it for a caller with a rule whose target is 'capability:{capability}' and effect 'allow', naming '{caller}' or a pattern matching it.
translations.CAPABILITY_REASON_NOT_OPENED: no rule opens it for this caller
translations.CAPABILITY_REASON_UNATTRIBUTED: the code using it could not be attributed to a leaf
translations.CAPABILITY_REASON_FOREIGN_FILENAME: it compiles under the name of a file outside the caller's own folder
translations.CAPABILITY_REASON_BINDING: Node's binding compiles under names that cannot be checked
translations.PERMISSION_SELF_MODIFY: Module '{moduleID}' cannot remove its own permission rule '{ruleId}'
translations.HINT_PERMISSION_SELF_MODIFY: Permission rules are immutable for the owning module. Another module must remove this rule.
translations.HINT_INVALID_PERMISSION_RULE: Permission rules require: caller (string glob), target (string glob), and effect ('allow' or 'deny').
translations.DEBUG_PERMISSION_SELF_BYPASS: Permission self-bypass: caller and target share moduleID '{moduleID}'
translations.DEBUG_PERMISSION_DEFAULT: Permission default policy applied: caller '{caller}' -> target '{target}' -> {effect}
translations.DEBUG_PERMISSION_CONDITION_THENABLE: Permission condition returned a Promise (target: {target}); conditions are synchronous, so the rule does not match
translations.DEBUG_PERMISSION_PRINCIPAL_UNAVAILABLE: Principal {principal} unavailable for {target} ({reason}); the rule requiring it does not match
translations.PERM_RULE_NOT_OBJECT: rule must be a non-null object
translations.PERM_RULE_CALLER_REQUIRED: rule.caller must be a non-empty string
translations.PERM_RULE_TARGET_REQUIRED: rule.target must be a non-empty string
translations.PERM_RULE_TARGET_NOT_OWNED: module code manages rules only for the subtree its module owns, never for the framework's namespace, root functions, or internal keys, unless an explicit allow on "slothlet.permissions.rules.add" lifts that default
translations.PERM_RULE_REMOVAL_NOT_OWNED: module code removes only the rules its own module owns; a module allowed to manage rules also removes other modules' rules, never the host's or the framework's
translations.PERM_RULE_FIELD_ACCESSOR: rule fields must be plain data properties, not accessors
translations.PERMISSION_RULE_UNKNOWN_TARGET: The rule target '{target}' names nothing slothlet has: no member of the slothlet namespace or built-in capability ({capabilities}) matches it, so the rule could never apply.
translations.HINT_PERMISSION_RULE_UNKNOWN_TARGET: Check the target's spelling against the slothlet namespace, or name a capability as 'capability:<name>'.
translations.PERM_EVENT_RULE_EVENT_REQUIRED: rule.event must be a non-empty string
translations.PERM_RULE_CONDITION_INVALID: rule.condition must be a plain object, a function, or an array where each entry is a plain object or function
translations.PERM_RULE_CONDITION_PROXY: rule.condition must not be or contain a Proxy
translations.PERM_RULE_REQUIRES_INVALID: rule.requires must be a non-empty array of principal names (non-empty strings)
translations.BRACE_EXPANSION_MAX_DEPTH: Brace expansion exceeded maximum depth of {maxDepth}
translations.HINT_BRACE_EXPANSION_MAX_DEPTH: Reduce nesting in your brace patterns or increase the maxDepth option.
translations.PERMISSION_MANAGER_NOT_AVAILABLE: Permission manager is not available in this Slothlet instance
translations.MODULE_MANIFEST_INVALID: Module manifest is invalid for package '{package}' at '{manifest}': {reason}.
translations.HINT_MODULE_MANIFEST_INVALID: Open the manifest and ensure it is valid JSON and matches the slothlet module schema (see schemas/slothlet.module.schema.json). Required fields: schema, mount, base.
translations.MODULE_MANIFEST_REASON_NOT_OBJECT: manifest must be a JSON object
translations.MODULE_MANIFEST_REASON_MIXED_FORMATS: it mixes format 2 fields (schema, mount, base) with format 1 fields (schemaVersion, mountPath, apiDir)
translations.MODULE_MANIFEST_REASON_MOUNT_SHAPE: field '{field}' must be a non-empty string or non-empty array of non-empty strings
translations.MODULE_MANIFEST_REASON_MOUNT_ENTRIES: field '{field}' array entries must all be non-empty strings
translations.MODULE_MANIFEST_REASON_DEPENDENCY_TYPE: dependency '{dependency}' must be a string version range
translations.MODULE_MANIFEST_REASON_PERMISSION_RULE: permissions[{index}] must be a rule object
translations.MODULE_MANIFEST_REASON_PERMISSION_CALLER: permissions[{index}].caller must be a non-empty string
translations.MODULE_MANIFEST_REASON_PERMISSION_TARGET: permissions[{index}].target must be a non-empty string
translations.MODULE_MANIFEST_REASON_EVENT_NAME: events[{index}].event must be a non-empty string
translations.GENERATE_MANIFEST_DIR_INVALID: generateManifest: dir must be a non-empty string, received {received}
translations.GENERATE_BROWSER_ASSETS_SLOTHLET_BASE_IN: generateBrowserAssets: options.slothletBase must be a string (where @cldmv/slothlet is served in the browser), received {received}
translations.FILES_REQUIRES_NODE: {operation} needs Node.js: it reads the filesystem, which a browser does not have. Call it in your build step and hand its result to the page.
translations.MODULE_MANIFEST_UNKNOWN_FIELD: Module manifest for package '{package}' at '{manifest}' contains unrecognised top-level field '{field}'. Unknown fields are rejected; use the dedicated 'metadata' block for developer-defined extras.
translations.HINT_MODULE_MANIFEST_UNKNOWN_FIELD: If '{field}' is a typo, fix it. If it is intentional developer metadata, move it inside the 'metadata' object.
translations.MODULE_MANIFEST_NAME_MISMATCH: Module manifest for package '{package}' declares name '{received}' which does not match package.json name '{expected}'.
translations.HINT_MODULE_MANIFEST_NAME_MISMATCH: The 'name' field in slothlet.module.json is optional but must match package.json when present. Either remove the manifest 'name' field or align it with package.json.
translations.MODULE_MANIFEST_VERSION_MISMATCH: Module manifest for package '{package}' declares version '{received}' which does not match package.json version '{expected}'.
translations.HINT_MODULE_MANIFEST_VERSION_MISMATCH: The 'version' field in slothlet.module.json is optional but must match package.json when present. Either remove the manifest 'version' field or align it with package.json.
translations.MODULE_PATH_TRAVERSAL: Module package '{package}' has base '{base}' that resolves outside the package root ('{resolved}' is not under '{folder}').
translations.HINT_MODULE_PATH_TRAVERSAL: base must be a relative path that stays inside the package. Remove '..' segments and absolute paths.
translations.MODULE_MANIFEST_FORMAT_UNSUPPORTED: Module manifest for package '{package}' declares unsupported schema '{schema}'. Supported formats: 2 (current) and 1 (deprecated).
translations.HINT_MODULE_MANIFEST_FORMAT_UNSUPPORTED: Upgrade slothlet to a version that supports schema {schema}, or write the manifest in format 2: `schema` 2, `mount` and `base`.
translations.MODULE_DISCOVERY_REQUIRES_NODE: Module discovery ({operation}) needs Node.js: it reads the filesystem, which a browser does not have. Mount modules in the browser with api.slothlet.api.add() from the manifest instead.
translations.MODULE_PACKAGE_NOT_FOUND: Module package '{package}' was not found in the discovery cache. {hint}
translations.HINT_MODULE_PACKAGE_NOT_FOUND: Either the package is not installed, the discover.root does not cover its location, or no discover() call has been made yet. modules.add(name) will lazily run discover() with discover.root=process.cwd() if the cache is empty.
translations.MODULE_RESERVED_MOUNT: Module package '{package}' declares a mount ({mount}) whose first segment is reserved. Reserved roots: slothlet, shutdown, destroy.
translations.HINT_MODULE_RESERVED_MOUNT: Reserved mount roots are used by slothlet's built-in surface and cannot be claimed by modules. Choose a different root segment.
translations.WARNING_MODULE_MANIFEST_FORMAT_1: Module manifest for package '{package}' at '{manifest}' is written in format 1 (schemaVersion, mountPath, apiDir). It was read and mapped to format 2.
translations.HINT_WARNING_MODULE_MANIFEST_FORMAT_1: Format 1 is deprecated. Rename schemaVersion (value 1) to schema (value 2), mountPath to mount and apiDir to base.
translations.MODULE_DUPLICATE_NAME_VERSION_MISMATCH: Module package '{package}' version '{version}' was found at multiple distinct real paths: {paths}.
translations.HINT_MODULE_DUPLICATE_NAME_VERSION_MISMA: This is almost certainly a misconfiguration — the same package at the same version installed in two unrelated locations. Investigate which install is intended and remove the other.
translations.MODULE_MOUNT_COLLISION: Module package '{package}' cannot mount at '{mount}': path is already occupied by module '{existingModuleID}' and collision.mode is '{collisionMode}'.
translations.HINT_MODULE_MOUNT_COLLISION: Either change the manifest's mount, pass `collision: "merge"` to `modules.add()` to allow coexistence, or call `modules.remove()` on the existing module first.
translations.ROUTINE_FAILED: Routine contributor from module '{moduleID}' at '{apiPath}' failed: {error} ({count} failure(s) total: {failures}).
translations.HINT_ROUTINE_FAILED: Fix the throwing contributor, or catch and handle the failure inside it — every contributor in the routine's chain still runs even after one throws, and a single aggregated error listing every failure is thrown afterward (see `context.failures`).
translations.HOOK_UNPINNED_IGNORED: pin: false was ignored for hook '{pattern}'; hooks are pinned to their registering module. Set hook.pin:false (init) or call api.slothlet.hook.pin.disable() to permit unpinned hooks.
translations.HINT_HOOK_UNPINNED_IGNORED: Module-registered hooks are always pinned to their owner for security. To allow unpinned hooks, set hook.pin:false in the slothlet config, or call api.slothlet.hook.pin.disable() at runtime.
translations.CONTEXT_KEY_PROTECTED: Context key '{key}' is owner-locked; '{writer}' cannot write it (owner: {owner}).
translations.CONTEXT_KEY_OWNED: Context key '{key}' is already owned and cannot be re-claimed by a nested scope.
translations.SCOPE_INVALID_PROTECT: 'protect' must be an array of string keys. Received: {received}.
translations.SCOPE_INVALID_OWNERS: 'owners' must be a plain object mapping keys to owner names. Received: {received}.
translations.PERMISSION_SEALED: The permission control surface is sealed; policy can no longer be modified.
translations.RESTART_REFERENCE_UNRESOLVED: The reference to '{apiPath}' was held across a restart, and '{apiPath}' no longer exists in the restarted API.
translations.HINT_RESTART_REFERENCE_UNRESOLVED: A held reference re-resolves its path in the restarted instance on every use. Re-read the value from the api root, or check that the original config still produces '{apiPath}' — runtime add() mounts are not carried over by restart().
translations.PRINCIPAL_NAME_OWNED: Principal '{name}' is owned by '{owner}' and cannot be registered by '{claimant}'.
translations.PRINCIPAL_NOT_OWNER: Operation '{operation}' on principal '{name}' is reserved for its owner ('{owner}') or the host; caller: '{caller}'.
translations.PRINCIPAL_READ_ONLY: Principal '{name}' is read-only; its value is replaced only when it is resolved again.
translations.WARNING_COVERAGE_IMPORTER_UNSET: A coverage run is active but no injectable leaf importer is configured — this externalised slothlet's leaf loads will not attribute to your coverage report.
translations.HINT_WARNING_COVERAGE_IMPORTER_UNSET: Pass the 'loader.import' option from your test setup — a function like (url) => import(url) — so leaf loads ride your runner's module graph. See docs/TESTING.md.
translations.WARNING_COVERAGE_TS_SOURCEMAP_OFF: A coverage run is active and TypeScript leaves are loading with typescript.sourcemap set to false — their coverage is recorded against the transpiled .slothlet-cache copies and cannot reach the .ts sources.
translations.HINT_WARNING_COVERAGE_TS_SOURCEMAP_OFF: Remove typescript.sourcemap: false (it turns on automatically during a coverage run) or set it to true, and add the cache directory (.slothlet-cache/**) to your coverage include. See docs/TESTING.md.
translations.HOOK_VERSION_UNRESOLVED: Hook pattern '{pattern}' could not be resolved to a registered version.
translations.HINT_HOOK_VERSION_UNRESOLVED: Version dispatch needs a versioned mount covering the pattern's path (api.add(path, source, { version: { tag } })). A dispatcher must return a registered tag, an array of them, or nothing to take the default version — or drop the versioning option to register the pattern literally.
translations.HOOK_VERSION_UNKNOWN_TAG: Version dispatch for hook pattern '{pattern}' selected '{version}', which is not a registered version.
translations.HINT_HOOK_VERSION_UNKNOWN_TAG: The dispatcher must select from the registered tags it was handed in allVersions. Register the mount first (api.add with a version), or fix the dispatcher's return value.
translations.PERMISSION_STRICT_FIXED: The permissions mode "strict" is chosen in the config and cannot be changed at runtime (control.{method}).
translations.HINT_PERMISSION_STRICT_FIXED: Set permissions.mode in the config instead: once an instance has started, strict can be neither left nor entered.
translations.PERMISSION_BASELINE_UNMET: Permissions mode "strict" refuses to start: these baseline checks are not met: {checks}.
translations.HINT_PERMISSION_BASELINE_UNMET: Start the instance with mode "on" and read api.slothlet.permissions.control.report() for the reason of each check; docs/PERMISSIONS.md lists what each one needs.
translations.WARNING_PERMISSION_BASELINE_UNMET: Permission baseline check "{check}" is not met: {reason}
translations.HINT_WARNING_PERMISSION_BASELINE_UNMET: Each check is a fact about how the host runs slothlet; docs/PERMISSIONS.md says what each one needs. Under mode "strict" the instance would not start.
translations.BASELINE_CSP_EVAL_ALLOWED: the page lets code be made from strings: its Content Security Policy allows 'unsafe-eval', or it has none.
translations.BASELINE_CSP_BLOB_ALLOWED: the page runs scripts from blob: URLs: its Content Security Policy allows them, or it has none.
translations.BASELINE_CSP_DATA_ALLOWED: the page runs scripts from data: URLs: its Content Security Policy allows them, or it has none.
translations.BASELINE_VITEST_PLUGIN_ABSENT: running under vitest without slothlet's @cldmv/slothlet/vite plugin in the vitest config.
translations.INVALID_CONFIG_UNKNOWN_KEY: Unknown key '{key}' in {where}. It is not an option slothlet v4 has.
translations.HINT_INVALID_CONFIG_UNKNOWN_KEY: Check the key for a typo. Code written for slothlet v3 can be moved to the v4 names with npx @cldmv/slothlet-migrate.
